subject.title: feat(mac): native pairing approval dialog with instant decisions

question: Should macOS pairing approvals permanently dismiss optimistically before gateway confirmation, using notifications and card restoration to communicate the authoritative outcome?
rationale: This intentionally changes a sensitive approval interaction from confirmation-bound UI to optimistic UI; automated checks can validate mechanics, but maintainers must accept the user-facing confirmation model.

options.title: Adopt optimistic decisions
options.body: Keep instant dismissal, requiring localized failure copy and native proof of dismissal, reconciliation, and restoration before merge.

options.title: Keep confirmation-bound cards
options.body: Retain cards until gateway confirmation and limit this PR to native window chrome and visual cleanup.

recommendation.title: Adopt optimistic decisions
recommendation.body: Keep instant dismissal, requiring localized failure copy and native proof of dismissal, reconciliation, and restoration before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced and most recently shaped the exact pairing-panel behavior under review.
